name: Disrespectful Children
overview: Scripture commands children to honor and respect their parents, promising long life as a blessing for obedience (Exodus 20:12). The seriousness of disrespect is underscored by the severe consequences prescribed for striking or reviling one's father or mother, including the death penalty (Exodus 21:15, 21:17; Leviticus 20:9). A stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey even after correction is identified as a grave problem requiring firm parental authority (Deuteronomy 21:18), and loving discipline is emphasized as essential for guiding children rightly (Proverbs 13:24). Together, these verses affirm the biblical mandate for children’s respect and the necessity of godly parental discipline.
